description: User story under REQ-191 for the separation verb (FBS-222). Range from the merge-base with origin/main to HEAD, merge commits skipped, Hand: trailer over the five estate hands, default path classes at any depth, one quotable line and --json rows.
asA: a gate reviewer reading a build pull request
iWant: one line that says whether any commit crossed hands
soThat: I quote it instead of re-reading every diff

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a branch whose commits are a Hand: test-author commit touching test/x.test.js and rcf/user-stories/us-1.json, a Hand: builder commit touching src/x.js and rcf/code-nodes/cn-1.json, and a Hand: verifier commit touching rcf/verify-reports/FBS-1/abc.json, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0 and prints "separation: PASS 3 commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): test-author 1, builder 1, verifier 1, stage-keeper 0, neutral 0, undeclared 0, exceptions 0".
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: the stage prefix replaces the Hand trailer (ADR ADR-4153; operator ruling Q-02 refinement 2, ledger). Successor judges prefixed commits against per-stage classes.

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] Given a Hand: builder commit that touches test/x.test.js, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 and prints "separation: FAIL 1 of <n> commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): <sha7> Hand=builder touches test/x.test.js"; the same holds for a Hand: test-author commit touching src/, and for a Hand: builder commit touching rcf/user-stories/.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: a builder crossing into tests is now judged by the BUILD: prefix and the rcfTest class (ADR ADR-4153).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [edge] Given an undeclared commit touching only src/ and another touching only test/, when the verb runs, then both pass and are counted under undeclared; an undeclared commit touching both src/ and test/ fails exit 4 naming both paths.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: undeclared commits no longer pass; every commit needs a stage prefix (ADR ADR-4153).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] Given --base naming a ref that does not exist, the verb exits 2 with "separation: bad ref <ref>"; run outside a git repository it exits 1 with "separation: not a git repository"; a Hand: value outside the five hands and mixed is reported as a violation with reason "unknown hand <value>".
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: the Hand: value check is gone with the trailer; the bad ref, not-a-repository and shallow refusals carry over in the successor (ADR ADR-4153).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given the same branch as the PASS case, when rcf audit separation --json runs, then stdout is a JSON array with one SeparationRow per non-merge commit { sha, subject, hand, declared, classes, verdict, reason, paths } and merge commits in the range are absent.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: SeparationRow v2 replaces hand and declared with stage, role and handTrailer, and lists merges (ADR ADR-4153).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [must-not] rcf audit separation never writes a file, never reads the network and never reads the chain: two runs over the same range print byte-identical output and leave git status unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-24: the audit now reads verdict records and rcf/separation.json through git at commits in the range; the successor states the read-only, git-only rule in those terms (ADR ADR-4153).

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a committed report under rcf/verify-reports/, when rcf audit separation runs over the commit that adds it, then it classifies the path as verifier evidence.

title: rcf audit separation judges each commit's hand against the paths it touches
